hero.title: Track your time. Analyze where it goes.
hero.subtitle: TimeGrip is a simple, fast time-tracking service — organize projects, log hours, and see exactly where your time goes.

featuresTitle: Everything you need, nothing you don’t

projects.title: Projects, organized
projects.description: Group work into color-coded projects, archive the ones you’re done with, and keep everything easy to scan at a glance.

tracking.title: Live or manual tracking
tracking.description: Start a timer the moment you begin working, or back-fill entries after the fact — both stay perfectly in sync.

reports.title: Reports that make sense
reports.description: Bar and pie breakdowns by project, flexible date ranges, and instant totals so you always know where your hours went.

billing.title: Automatic rate calculations
billing.description: Set an hourly rate per project, optionally round to the nearest hour, and see billable amounts calculated automatically.

devices.title: Designed for every screen
devices.description: A responsive interface for desktop and mobile, with light and dark themes that follow your system or switch manually anytime.

api.title: A real REST API
api.description: Every feature is backed by a fully documented API — build your own integrations or automate your workflow.

projects.title: Projects that are well‑organized and clear
projects.description: Color-code projects for quick visual scanning, set a per-project hourly rate, and archive completed work without losing its history.

timers.title: Timers that fit how you work
timers.description: Start and stop a live timer, or add and edit manual entries for time you tracked elsewhere. Overlapping entries are caught automatically.

reports.title: Reports you can act on
reports.description: Filter by date range, project, or billable status, group totals by project or by day, and export the whole thing to CSV whenever you need it elsewhere.

api.title: A fully documented REST API
api.description: Everything in the app is backed by a REST API. Browse the full reference anytime — sign in to get a token and build your own integrations.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.description: TimeGrip's full source is on GitHub. Bring your own server and spin up Postgres, the API, the frontend, and nginx with a single Docker Compose command — no vendor lock-in, no hidden fees.

mobile.title: Works just as well on your phone
mobile.subtitle: The same responsive interface, so you can log time on your phone without opening a laptop.

cta.title: Ready to see where your time goes?
cta.subtitle: Create a free account and start tracking your time.
